operation_details.item: The user's Deal A is in the negotiation stage.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning. Just pulled up the pipeline view to prep for the weekly sync. Looks like Deal A moved into the negotiation stage, which is great but also means I need to sharpen the pricing strategy.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good morning! Nice to see that momentum. How are the client relationships on the other deals shaping up? I recall you were keeping a close eye on the proposal and discovery stages too.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, Deal B is still in the proposal stage, and Deal C just started discovery. Both are solid but need different attention — B is about reassuring the procurement team, C is more about scoping pain points.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. Since all stages are tracked in the pipeline view, it must help you spot where to spend your time. Negotiation can be tricky — are you thinking about trade-offs or mostly holding firm on the last offer?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Holding firm, but I want to offer a couple of value-adds that don't cut into margin. The client's main concern seems to be implementation support, so I might bundle that in to close the gap.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That's a classic consultative move — anchoring value instead of price. And with Deal B still in proposal, you can reuse some of that thinking if they push back later. How's your team dividing the follow-ups?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: One rep owns B and C while I handle A directly. That way I can give the negotiation my full attention, and they get ownership of the earlier-stage deals. The pipeline view makes it easy to check progress without micromanaging.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Sounds like a healthy balance. So for today's sync, the headline is Deal A in negotiation, with B and C running their courses. Anything else you want to think through before the numbers go on the slide?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I think we're good. I just want to make sure the forecast reflects realistic probabilities — A at 60%, B at 30%, C still exploratory. I'll update the notes after the call.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the stage of Deal A, while keeping the stages for Deals B and C and the pipeline tracking.
